verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.growthbook.io/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 and indexes a 181-page aggregated markdown docs bundle (_llms/docs.md). Docs pages are also served as .md, and the official MCP server loads GrowthBook Agent Skills (workflows and guardrails) for agents. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents using the llms.txt and markdown docs in practice, and any documentation of how the llms.txt is structured or maintained.
